timing_policy: Playback cadence and source video runtime format are derived only from the saved source clip facts and the player/audio clock. Do not use display Hz, UI repaint rate, project/export FPS, project field order, project color or hardcoded defaults as source playback cadence/format.
audio_policy: Apply DB-read project_audio to source preview output without changing native media metadata. Keep channels separate in saved source order; A1/A2 are two mono lanes, not a stereo fallback, even when they come from the same multichannel stream. No caller routing override. Reject unavailable source channels, unsupported device formats or sample-rate conversion before opening the output. Current decoder uses native sample rate; differing project rate is an explicit unsupported-format error, not a fallback.
